notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
Due to increasing demand the game was made easier especially on Normal difficulty.


 Increased Max ammo for Dispersion pistol from 12 to 15
 Increased recharge rate for Dispersion pistol from 1 to 1.1
 Increased base Max ammo for Pulse gun 180 to 220
 Increased Max ammo for Rocket launcher 25 to 35
 Decreased damage of Thorn (poison spitting monster)
 Decreased Imp's Fireball flying speed
 Decreased number of spawned enemies during summoning phase on Burial Grounds level (second boss fight)
 Decreased time in which Red key reaches ground on Hall of Sins by 20 seconds
 Decreased number of monsters on Normal difficulty levels
 Added more pickups (health, armor, ammo) on Normal difficulty levels

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
- increased shotgun close range by 3 meters, mid range by 10 meters
- increased shotgun damage by 1 for each pellet
- added additonal Save books (checkpoints) to every level
- added bonus demon souls for each unused save book at the end of level

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Based on the feedback and analytics (thanks to all who kept analytics enabled, its very helpful) I made The Black Gate (the first level) slightly easier on Normal difficulty.
Imp the fireball throwing demon was also slightly nerfed to feel less deadly. 

The Black Gate (Normal)

 added two more health pickups
 decreased number of enemies in some encounters

Imp

 decreased fireball speed and damage
 decreased chance to lead shots

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
- fixed issue where players could get stuck in secret room on Ramparts
- decreased price for repairing a relic from 500 souls to 300 souls
- increased chances for successful relic upgrade
